changelog: Click Install. When app closes, rename .exe.new to .exe. (Full details: Delete old UnknownBearTranslator.exe and rename UnknownBearTranslator.exe.new to .exe, or download fresh from GitHub.)
downloader_changelog: Single-file forum drop. Unpacks WebView2 helpers into LocalAppData on first run. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Reads app_manifest.json and downloads the Translator tag listed there (currently translator-v1.0.2).
